## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize failure paths before matching — For `report={"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]}` and `requested={"tests/test_x.py"}`, your selector returns `[]` instead of `["./tests/test_x.py"]`. It compares raw report paths, whereas `select_explicit` normalizes paths for matching while preserving their original spelling. — Users silently omit requested failing tests when runner reports contain `./`-prefixed paths. — Fix: Compare `normalize(path)` against `requested` while returning the original `path`.
